Why you should uncrust your crusty dog! 🫣 Leaving too much buildup on your dog for too long can cause irritation and discomfort for your pet. The best way to prevent this is with regular grooming, keeping the eyes clean and cleared, cleaning around the eyes daily with pet friendly eye wipes, and finding the source of the irritant. It’s also beneficial to look into things that support healthy tear production like filtered water and supplements. Always make sure to use a gentle facial cleanser to avoid irritating their eyes and face. Living with dogs means accepting that you will quite literally never have a snack that belongs only to you. The second Bailey hears a chip bag opening, it’s basically a whistle telling her to sprint over as fast as physically possible. Suddenly, my quick little snack break turns into a full-on shareable feast because apparently everything I eat must be inspected and sampled by her too. Then I sit there wondering how she became so ridiculously spoiled like I’m not the one handing over little bites every single time.
